Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Ruth Bader Ginsburg as the first woman appointed to the U.S. Supreme Court (it was Sandra Day O’Connor). This misidentification led the investigation toward Ginsburg’s education instead of O’Connor’s, which would have produced the wrong educational institutions. The error first appeared in the Planner’s initial message (step 2) and set the task on the wrong path until later corrected.
